[[Ritualist Insignia]] }} Advanced training for [[Cantha]]ns. Teaches how to defend against [[Melee]] attackers. == Quest information == === Requirements === {{Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | active = Any [[insignia quest]] }} === Objectives === * Speak to [[Weng Gha]]. * Talk to Weng Gha again to begin your test. * Use defensive skills to survive attacks for 2 minutes, or defeat [[Jinzo]] and [[Weng Gha]]. * See Instructor Ng for your reward. === Early benefits === Skills provided: * {{w}} {{skill icon|Defensive Stance}} * {{r}} {{skill icon|Throw Dirt}} * {{mo}} {{skill icon|Shielding Hands}} * {{n}} {{skill icon|Enfeebling Blood}} * {{me}} {{skill icon|Clumsiness}} * {{e}} {{skill icon|Ward Against Melee}} * {{a}} {{skill icon|Blinding Powder}} * {{rt}} {{skill icon|Shadowsong}} === Reward === * 500 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] == Walkthrough == If you can, just defeat them. Otherwise, use the skills you gained when accepting the quest to stay alive for as long as you can.
Also, since Weng Gha will be using [[Drunken Blow]], bring a [[List_of_condition_removal_skills|condition removal skill]]. == NPCs == * {{W}} 10 (20) [[Weng Gha]] * {{A}} 10 (20) [[Jinzo]] == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Instructor Ng :''"Within the monastery we are safe, but in order to survive outside these walls, you must learn to defend yourself. In this training exercise, you will be attacked by two of our instructors: Weng Gha and Jinzo. I will provide you with defensive skills; use them to survive their attacks for two full minutes.'' :''By accepting this quest you will abandon other advanced training quests and put yourself into a separate training arena from the rest of your party, if applicable."'' {{Offer dialog | accept = Sounds straightforward enough. | decline = I'm not sure I can survive for two minutes. | ask = There are many different defenses available to you. Go and show off your skills to Weng Gha and Jinzo in the Dojo. }} === Intermediate dialogue === ;Weng Gha :''«name», I hope you are ready with your defensive skills. Jinzo and I are going to force you to use them."'' ;Weng Gha :''"Ready...begin!"'' :'''When Gha:''' ''"This apprentice does not look very tough to me, Jinzo. Perhaps we should take it easy."'' :'''Jinzo:''' ''"We shall see, Weng Gha. This one may have more skill than you think."'' :'''Weng Gha:''' ''"Your challenge begins now. Survive for two minutes."'' :'''Jinzo:''' ''"Good! Keep going; you are doing well."'' :'''Weng Gha:''' ''"Excellent work! You are almost there...just a little while longer..."'' :'''Jinzo:''' ''"You have done well, [Character Name]. Return to Instructor Ng to receive credit for this course."'' === Reward dialogue === ;Instructor Ng :''"Well done. You have mastered the art of defense. This skill is especially useful when battling opponents, such as Warriors, who use melee attacks."'' ==Notes== * Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are [[Weh no Su]]. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills. [[Category:Training]]
